WITH mol_weights AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id,
         SUM(
           CASE a.element
             WHEN 'h'  THEN 1.008
             WHEN 'c'  THEN 12.011
             WHEN 'n'  THEN 14.007
             WHEN 'o'  THEN 15.999
             WHEN 'f'  THEN 18.998
             WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
             WHEN 'br' THEN 79.904
             WHEN 'i'  THEN 126.904
             WHEN 'p'  THEN 30.974
             WHEN 's'  THEN 32.06
             WHEN 'na' THEN 22.990
             WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.078
             WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.710
             WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.2
             WHEN 'te' THEN 127.60
             ELSE 0
           END
         ) AS total_weight,
         SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hydrogen_count,
         m.label
  FROM "atom" a
  LEFT JOIN "molecule" m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         total_weight,
         hydrogen_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_weight DESC) AS rnk
  FROM mol_weights
)
-- Top 10 molecules by total molecular weight
SELECT molecule_id,
       total_weight,
       hydrogen_count,
       rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 10
ORDER BY rnk;

-- Average molecular weight per carcinogenic label
SELECT label,
       AVG(total_weight) AS average_weight
FROM mol_weights
GROUP BY label
ORDER BY label;

        a.molecule_id,
        SUM(CASE a.element
            WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.5
            WHEN 'c' THEN 12
            WHEN 'h' THEN 1
            WHEN 'o' THEN 16

        SUM(CASE WHEN a.element='h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hydrogen_count
    FROM atom a
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
),
label_avg AS (
    SELECT
        m.label,
        AVG(ms.total_weight) AS avg_weight_label
    FROM mol_stats ms
    JOIN molecule m ON ms.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.label
)
SELECT

    ms.hydrogen_count,
    la.avg_weight_label
FROM mol_stats ms
JOIN molecule m ON ms.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

    FROM molecule

    FROM carcinogenic c

           inspection_count,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inspection_count DESC) AS rn,

)

       NULL AS inspection_dates,
       NULL AS risk_score
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= CEIL(total * 0.1)
ORDER BY inspection_count DESC;

WITH mol_weight AS (
    SELECT m.molecule_id,
           SUM(
               CASE a.element
                   WHEN 'c' THEN 12.01
                   WHEN 'h' THEN 1.008
                   WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
                   WHEN 'o' THEN 16.00
                   WHEN 'n' THEN 14.01
                   WHEN 's' THEN 32.06
                   WHEN 'p' THEN 30.97
                   WHEN 'na' THEN 22.99
                   WHEN 'br' THEN 79.90
                   WHEN 'f' THEN 19.00
                   WHEN 'i' THEN 126.90
                   WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.71
                   WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.2
                   WHEN 'te' THEN 127.6
                   WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.08
                   ELSE 0
               END
           ) AS weight
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
SELECT AVG(weight) AS average_molecular_weight
FROM mol_weight;

WITH per_mol AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        m.label,
        SUM(CASE a.element
                WHEN 'h'  THEN 1.0079
                WHEN 'c'  THEN 12.011
                WHEN 'n'  THEN 14.007
                WHEN 'o'  THEN 15.999
                WHEN 'f'  THEN 18.998
                WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
                WHEN 'br' THEN 79.904
                WHEN 'i'  THEN 126.904
                WHEN 's'  THEN 32.06
                WHEN 'p'  THEN 30.974
                WHEN 'na' THEN 22.989
                WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.71
                WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.2
                WHEN 'te' THEN 127.6
                WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.078
                ELSE 0
            END) AS molecular_weight,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN b.bond_id END) AS single_bond_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN b.bond_id END) AS double_bond_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN b.bond_id END) AS triple_bond_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_count
    FROM molecule m
    LEFT JOIN atom a   ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    LEFT JOIN bond b   ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT
    per_mol.molecule_id AS smiles,
    per_mol.molecular_weight,
    per_mol.single_bond_count,
    per_mol.double_bond_count,
    per_mol.triple_bond_count,
    avg_cl.avg_chlorine AS avg_chlorine_per_label
FROM per_mol
JOIN (
    SELECT label, AVG(chlorine_count) AS avg_chlorine
    FROM per_mol
    GROUP BY label
) avg_cl ON avg_cl.label = per_mol.label
ORDER BY per_mol.molecular_weight DESC;

WITH mol_weight AS (
    SELECT a.molecule_id,
           SUM(CASE a.element
                 WHEN 'h'  THEN 1.008
                 WHEN 'c'  THEN 12.01
                 WHEN 'n'  THEN 14.01
                 WHEN 'o'  THEN 16.00
                 WHEN 's'  THEN 32.07
                 WHEN 'p'  THEN 30.97
                 WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
                 WHEN 'na' THEN 22.99
                 WHEN 'br' THEN 79.90
                 WHEN 'f'  THEN 19.00
                 WHEN 'i'  THEN 126.90
                 WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.71
                 WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.20
                 WHEN 'te' THEN 127.60
                 WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.08
                 ELSE 0
               END) AS weight
    FROM "atom" a
    GROUP BY a.molecule_id
)
SELECT m.label,
       AVG(mw.weight) AS avg_molecular_weight
FROM mol_weight mw
JOIN "molecule" m ON mw.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY m.label;

SELECT AVG(mw) AS avg_molecular_weight FROM (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label,
         SUM(CASE a.element
           WHEN 'c' THEN 12.01
           WHEN 'h' THEN 1.008
           WHEN 'o' THEN 16.00
           WHEN 'n' THEN 14.01
           WHEN 'cl' THEN 35.45
           WHEN 'br' THEN 79.90
           WHEN 's' THEN 32.07
           WHEN 'p' THEN 30.97
           WHEN 'na' THEN 22.99
           WHEN 'f' THEN 19.00
           WHEN 'i' THEN 126.90
           WHEN 'sn' THEN 118.71
           WHEN 'pb' THEN 207.2
           WHEN 'ca' THEN 40.08
           WHEN 'te' THEN 127.60
           ELSE 0
         END) AS mw
  FROM atom a
  JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
) GROUP BY label

WITH atom_weights AS (
    SELECT
        a.molecule_id,
        CASE
            WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 35.45
            WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 12.01
            WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1.008
            WHEN a.element = 'o' THEN 16.00
            WHEN a.element = 's' THEN 32.07
            WHEN a.element = 'n' THEN 14.01
            WHEN a.element = 'p' THEN 30.97
            WHEN a.element = 'na' THEN 22.99
            WHEN a.element = 'br' THEN 79.90
            WHEN a.element = 'f' THEN 19.00
            WHEN a.element = 'i' THEN 126.90
            WHEN a.element = 'sn' THEN 118.71
            WHEN a.element = 'pb' THEN 207.2
            WHEN a.element = 'te' THEN 127.6
            WHEN a.element = 'ca' THEN 40.08
            ELSE 0
        END AS weight
    FROM atom a
),
mol_weight AS (
    SELECT
        molecule_id,
        SUM(weight) AS molecular_weight
    FROM atom_weights
    GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT
    m.label,
    AVG(mw.molecular_weight) AS avg_molecular_weight
FROM mol_weight mw
JOIN molecule m ON mw.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
GROUP BY m.label;

WITH elem_counts AS (
    SELECT a.element,
           a.molecule_id,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM atom a
    JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE m.label = '+'
    GROUP BY a.element, a.molecule_id
),
avg_weights AS (
    SELECT element,
           AVG(cnt) AS avg_weight
    FROM elem_counts
    GROUP BY element
),
bond_to_n AS (
    SELECT a1.element AS element,
